item.tib: ma mo sbod gtong snang srid zil gnon gyi rgyud las zhi sgrub ye shes rang gsal
item.coloph: zhes ma mo rbod gtong snang srid zil gnon gyi zhi sgrab ye shes rang gsal 'di ni mkha' 'gro brda yi shog ser las 'os tsam byung ba ltar khro chen rgyal po'i nang so mu la wer ya sogs kyi thugs bzhed du kho bo kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po can gyis gu ge ris su phab pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor rnams kyis dga' ston du spel ba'o
